notes: Intro: Meadowfell builds an AI assistant layer for mid-market B2B SaaS products (in-app help, knowledge search, automated summaries).

POC summary: 2-week Dedicated eval (managed edge) — focused on chat & embeddings workflows. Key results: 1) p95 gen latency 130–180ms for 512-token responses in eu-west, 2) embedding throughput 150 reqs/s with batching, 3) reranking micro-benchmarks show 45% reduction in token spend with prefix caching.

Workload profile & targets: primary workload = customer support chat (50% traffic), doc search (30%), background batch embeddings (20%). Latency SLO: 250ms end-to-end for chat median, p95 < 400ms. Throughput target: sustained 60 rps baseline, ability to burst to 180 rps during peak windows.
Current Hosted usage: ~90M tokens/month across models (generation + embeddings). POC observed cost reduction when moving to Dedicated with quantized model variant (~25% savings on token ops).

Pricing ask (customer): wants 6-month ramped commit with monthly true-up and burst allowance. Overage: propose 1.6x unit price vs committed rate; customer pushing for 1.25x for first 2 quarters.
